Status labels Open, Resolved, Declined; declined reason printed in the status banner; 'Owner: <name>' or 'Not assigned yet'.

Converted Request redirects to /portal/contracts/<n> or /portal/matters/<n> only while the record is not archived and the user is on its team; otherwise 404 to the Portal home. Requester sees only the full-thread tier on a Request; Legal Only and Working Team tiers stay hidden (CONTEXT.md DD-016 vocabulary).

Conversion records the Requester as Business Owner and adds a team row (CONTEXT.md, DD-023). The sentence that Legal may add other Business Users stays true; CONTEXT.md also lets Business Users add existing people to non-Confidential record teams, which this article does not cover.
Only published, Everyone, non-archived Knowledge Items open; draft, Legal Only, archived and unknown ids answer one 404 and redirect to /portal. The download route uses the same gate.
Deflection panel hides Knowledge links that fail the gate; Knowledge links open in the same tab, external links open in a new tab with the domain beneath the label.

Page shows 'From Legal' above the title, a 'Documents' card with 'Download' per file (primary Document sorted first, current Version only, no reader or version picker), then 'Guidance', and a 'Your requests' back link.
Portal navigation has Requests, Contracts, Matters, Auto-Docs and no Knowledge library.
Help search reads the documentation bundle only.
Portal Knowledge source changed only in its sign-in redirect (/portal/enter to /portal/login) in this range; no article change needed.

sharedFileRequests: docs/user-guides/request-forms.md line 34 says Department is optional on the form. INT-010 and commit 9287c0b1 make Department required on every new Request. The owner of request-forms should correct it.
productBugs: The Portal form requires a live Department, but a fresh instance creates no Departments (migrations 0116 and 0131 only migrate existing values). With no live Department, the required picker offers only the disabled 'Choose a Department' option, and no Business User can submit any Request. The form gives no hint that an Administrator must add a Department.
